name: Kōriyama (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōriyama town emblem in blue: a disc crossed by a white stylised mountain and bar.
history: Flag of the former town of Kōriyama in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1966.

features.role: Kōriyama town emblem — a disc crossed by a white stylised mountain and bar
